items.stem: Which procurement task is the best fit for AI assistance with human review?

options.text: Summarising and categorising a large spend dataset for analyst review
options.rationale: Correct: high-volume summarisation with human verification suits AI well.

options.text: Making the final supplier award decision autonomously
options.rationale: The award decision requires accountable human judgement.

options.text: Signing the contract on behalf of the company
options.rationale: Contract execution is an authority that AI cannot hold.
Policy requires human governance, not autonomous AI.

items.explanation: Correct: high-volume summarisation with human verification suits AI well.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: AI returns a claim that a supplier is in financial distress. Which TWO actions are appropriate before acting? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Verify the claim against a credible, current source
options.rationale: Correct: AI claims must be corroborated before they drive decisions.

options.text: Check whether the information is current and specific to that supplier
options.rationale: Correct: outdated or mismatched data would mislead the decision.

options.text: Immediately disqualify the supplier on the AI claim alone
options.rationale: Acting on an unverified claim is unfair and risky.

options.text: Share the unverified claim with competing suppliers
options.rationale: Spreading unverified claims is both unfair and a confidentiality risk.

items.explanation: Correct: AI claims must be corroborated before they drive decisions.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: You want AI help on a live tender but the bids are confidential. What is the safest approach?

options.text: Use a controlled tool with data-protection terms and avoid entering identifying bid detail
options.rationale: Correct: a controlled tool plus data minimisation protects confidentiality.

options.text: Paste all bids into a free public chatbot
options.rationale: Public tools can expose confidential competitive data.

options.text: Email the bids to the tool vendor for analysis
Share bids with one supplier to benchmark
options.rationale: Disclosing bids to a competitor is a serious breach.

items.explanation: Correct: a controlled tool plus data minimisation protects confidentiality.
